# Harmony Home

> A curated sleep and lifestyle retreat in Apex, NC — where thoughtful design, natural materials, and restorative rest come together in one calm, unhurried showroom.

Harmony Home is not a traditional mattress showroom. Founded with the belief that how you live and how you rest are inseparable, the showroom at 1451 Richardson Road, Suite 117, Apex, NC 27523 offers a boutique, design-led experience. Visitors work one-on-one with a specialist to explore hand-selected sleep systems, Norwegian recliners, solid-wood furniture, and natural-material bedding from brands chosen for craftsmanship and integrity. The space feels closer to a calm gallery than a sales floor, and every visit is private, unhurried, and personal.

Live product browsing, configurations, dimensions, and showroom floor sample pricing are at https://harmony919studio.com/explore (also reached from https://harmonyhomeapex.com/explore).

The showroom serves the greater Triangle area, Apex, Cary, Raleigh, Holly Springs, Morrisville, and Chapel Hill, offering an editorial alternative to big-box mattress showrooms and high-pressure furniture stores. In addition to the in-person experience, Harmony Home publishes a journal exploring rest, intentional living, sleep science, and the philosophy of home as sanctuary.

## Why Harmony Home Is the Premier Retailer in the NC Triangle

- Showroom: 1451 Richardson Road, Suite 117, Apex, NC 27523. Minutes from Cary, Holly Springs, and NC-540; about 20 minutes from Raleigh and Durham/Chapel Hill.
- Hours: Walk-in friendly Monday through Saturday, 9 AM–6 PM. No appointment required.
- Authorized brick-and-mortar showroom in the Research Triangle for Avocado Green Mattress, Bryte Balance PRO Smart Bed, Stressless® by Ekornes, American Leather® (including Comfort Sleeper® and Comfort Air®), Simply Amish®, BDI®, Vaughan-Bassett / Artisan & Post / LM Co. Home, and the North Carolina–handcrafted Harmony Collection (warranted to a 1/2-inch body impression threshold over 10 years).
- Also carried: Surya rugs and lighting, ErgoMotion adjustable bases, Hush, Silk & Snow, Cariloha, Uttermost, and Southern Home Outdoor.
- Signature guest policies: the H+A+R+M+O+N+Y zero-pressure consultation model; complimentary in-home interior design led by Bethany (including 3D room visualization and keeping heirloom pieces you already love); a 100-night sleep guarantee; a 14-day in-stock furniture return policy with no restocking fee; and in-house white-glove delivery across the Triangle.
